alignmentStatus: Approximate concept zones. Production cutouts and furniture contacts require alignment review before integration.

characterPolicy.design: Reuse Pip's existing approved artwork, customization assets, cels and timing.
characterPolicy.previewPose: pip-approved-pose.png is an unchanged copy of pip-chair-rest-v2.png.
characterPolicy.stageRule: Little Igloo keeps the live placement and interaction paths. Expanded-stage furniture must be aligned to the approved character before any runtime integration. Concept zone boxes do not replace live coordinates.

perspectiveAndLighting.camera: Same slightly elevated three-quarter view and portrait framing as the current personal igloo.
perspectiveAndLighting.primaryLight: Warm amber desk lantern in the lower-right study nook.
perspectiveAndLighting.ambientLight: Cool blue and lavender snow-wall bounce, with peach floor reflections.
perspectiveAndLighting.futureLights: Firelight is a separate warm secondary source; skylight and window effects remain separate from the shell.
perspectiveAndLighting.propRule: Each furniture variant shares a floor-contact anchor, perspective, scale envelope, separate contact shadow and any necessary foreground occluder.

proposedLayers.export: clean shell with transparent window openings; furniture excluded
clean floor without rugs, movable objects or furniture shadows
independent frame, glass, opening parts and trim per assembly
separate props with bottom-contact pivots and safe overlap margins
align against the approved sitting performance; do not repaint Pip
reuse unchanged; no new rig or animation system
individual anchored props that follow their parent furniture
independent lightweight effects using the existing workflow

contents: near-right snow wall and doorway edges

futureInteractionPlan.food: Optional tea, snack and serving-tray interactions, anchored to desk or kitchen surfaces.
futureInteractionPlan.maintenance: No hunger meters, compulsory feeding, decay, care debt or punishment.
futureInteractionPlan.furniture: Swap sofas, beds, desks, shelves, rugs and decorations independently, with shared contact anchors.
futureInteractionPlan.openFloor: Keep the central route between entrance, chair, bed and rear living bay free of new furniture.

stages.label: Little Igloo
stages.summary: The exact current home: a bed, familiar round window, bookshelf, braided rug and Pip's study nook.

stages.label: Cozy Igloo
stages.summary: A modest rear living bay adds a loveseat, fireplace and low storage while the study nook remains familiar.
stages.expansion: One shallow rear bay and more clear central floor, with a reserved roof socket for a later skylight.

stages.label: Dream Igloo
stages.summary: A stargazing skylight, snowy panorama and compact kitchen complete a roomy home with space still left to personalise.
stages.expansion: A wider rear living bay and a small kitchen alcove, rather than a larger furniture scale.
